# Hunter Tigert — Web Development

> Hunter Tigert is a front-end focused web developer based in Rockwall, Texas. He designs and builds fast, responsive websites and web applications — custom React and Tailwind builds, WordPress sites, and integrations with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pardot.

## Services
- Custom-built websites (React, Tailwind, or WordPress)
- Design and development
- Support and maintenance
- AI-accelerated builds

## Work
- [Content Freshness Dashboard](https://github.com/huntertigert/content-freshness-dashboard): tracks content freshness across SEO and AI search (GEO) performance.
- [Travel Journal](https://github.com/huntertigert/travel-journal): React app that builds a travel journal from structured trip data. Live: https://travel-journal-virid-gamma.vercel.app/
- [Content Summarizer](https://github.com/huntertigert/content-summarizer): CLI tool using the Claude API to summarize articles and write social captions.
